landing.heroTitle: Know how much you need before you can retire comfortably
landing.heroSubtitle: Calculate the nest egg you need at retirement, with a year-by-year savings plan that accounts for inflation and investment returns.

calculate.title: Calculate the corpus you need
calculate.description: Fill in your details once and instantly see how much you need at retirement, and how much to save each month to get there.

track.title: See your savings grow
track.description: Charts and a year-by-year table that already account for inflation and investment returns, no manual math required.

learn.title: Learn the financial basics
learn.description: Short, plain-language articles on compound interest, inflation, and risk before you start planning for real.

planForm.title: Fill in your details to plan for retirement
planForm.subtitle: The numbers beside the form update instantly as you type

basicCard.title: Basic information
basicCard.monthlyExpenseToday: Desired monthly expense after retirement (today's value)
basicCard.monthlyContribution: Amount you can actually save per month

pensionCard.title: Expected pension income
pensionCard.description: e.g. Social Security, government pension fund, provident fund
pensionCard.note: Enter today's value — the system will adjust for inflation automatically.

goalsCard.title: Special goals
goalsCard.description: e.g. buying a house, an overseas trip

validation.retirementAfterCurrent: Retirement age must be greater than current age
validation.lifeExpectancyAfterRetirement: Life expectancy must be greater than retirement age
validation.currentAgeRange: Current age must be between 15 and 80
validation.retirementAgeRange: Retirement age must be between 40 and 85
validation.lifeExpectancyRange: Life expectancy must be between 60 and 110

summary.comparedToActual: compared to what you can actually save

gapAlert.onTrackTitle: You're saving enough to reach your goal

recommend.title: Recommendations
recommend.onTrack: You're saving enough to reach your goal, with a surplus of {excess} THB.
recommend.increaseSaving: Increase savings to {requiredMonthly} THB/month (an increase of {increase} THB).
recommend.reduceExpense: Or reduce your post-retirement expense to {maxMonthlyExpenseToday} THB/month (today's value).
recommend.increaseRisk: Or shift to a higher-risk portfolio, which would close the gap but carries a higher chance of losing principal.

savingTips.title: Saving and investing principles
savingTips.payYourselfFirst: Pay yourself first — move money to savings as soon as your salary arrives.
savingTips.autoTransfer: Set up an automatic transfer on payday so you don't forget or spend it first.
savingTips.reviewYearly: Review your financial plan at least once a year.
savingTips.nearRetirement: As retirement gets closer (under 10 years away), gradually reduce your stock allocation to lower risk.

comparison.title: Comparing corpus calculation methods
comparison.note: When the post-retirement period is exactly 25 years, the simple method and the 4% rule always give the same result — this is not a bug.

disclaimer.title: Please note
disclaimer.body: This calculation is an estimate for educational purposes only, based on the assumptions you entered and expected rates of return that may not occur in reality. Past performance does not guarantee future returns, and investing carries the risk of losing principal. This website is not licensed investment advice. Before making real investment decisions, please consult a licensed investment advisor authorized by the Thai SEC.

results.pensionAssumption: The pension is calculated from the today's-value amount you entered, adjusted using the same inflation rate as your expenses.
results.pensionSufficient: Your expected pension is already sufficient to cover your expenses — no additional corpus is needed.
